# Y Combinator grad and AI insurance brokerage Harper raises $47M (TechCrunch)

By Dominic-Madori Davis. February 25, 2026.

## Key findings
- **Dakotah Rice**, co-founder & CEO of **Harper** (AI-native commercial insurance brokerage), announced **$46.8 million in a combined Series A and seed round**.
- Rice previously founded Poolit (closed 2023). Harper launched 2024; YC W25 batch.
- Harper is "an almost fully autonomous licensed commercial insurance agency" matching SMBs with 160+ carriers; AI handles submission routing, underwriter follow-ups, document collection, pipeline management.
- **Investors: YC, Lobster Capital, Peak XV Partners; Series A led by Emergence Capital.**
- 5,000+ customers; AI lets Harper handle 1,000+ customers/month vs 20–30 for a human-led broker.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — TechCrunch (top-tier tech outlet).
- Confirms the $46.8M combined round, Emergence Capital lead, and Rice as CEO/co-founder. Used for Q5.3, Q5.4.
